title: Sapa in a day
pace: One walk, or the cable car
summary: The stone church in the morning, then Cat Cat and the waterfall if the gate is open. The walk length is Check on arrival. Fansipan is the other way to spend the day.

stops.name: Stone church
stops.note: Spend about an hour at the stone church on the square.

stops.name: Cat Cat
stops.note: Continue to Cat Cat after the church.

stops.name: Cat Cat waterfall
stops.note: The waterfall sits inside the same Cat Cat walk.

additions.name: Fansipan
additions.note: Ride the cable car when this day is the peak instead of the village walk.
